exposure: high prenatal self-rating anxiety scale score
cohort: The cohort consisted of 287 women who underwent a cesarean section for early-onset preeclampsia between June 2014 and March 2024.
finding: Advanced age, previous preeclampsia, pre-pregnancy obesity, gestational diabetes mellitus, preexisting hypertension, PPD symptoms at 2 days postpartum, high prenatal anxiety, and pain at 6 weeks postpartum were independently associated with postpartum depression after cesarean section in women with early-onset preeclampsia.
